tools_separate_from_topics.description: Cross-domain finance tables and source-to-recipient chain
Scenario visualization; no validated real-time model
Multi-level Pueblo challenge with verified question bank and accessible play
Evidence prompts are optional, not primary answers

publication_gates: Every surfaced fact has a dated provenance and review state.
Each section can be partial without a completion percentage.
Direct, second-order, third-order entity links require distinct evidence and inference labels.
No release of held assertions, identifiable private-person allegations, or confidential case material.
All visual artwork is labeled illustrative where geography or history is composited.
All site images are real assets with credits/rights and not a screenshot used as interactive UI.
All production changes need ZIP checksum, manual Cloudflare deployment confirmation and reverse live readback.
